title: Pais told Ashton Forbes that the MH370 orbs show the Pais effect

tellings.quote: All I'm saying is when I saw that thing open up, I saw the pis effect on action and I told Ashen Ford that was his first podcast, hard truths podcast. I told him this is the Pis.

plain: Videos said to show glowing orbs around Malaysia Airlines flight MH370, the airliner that vanished in 2014, show the Pais effect in action, according to the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, whose name is on the effect, a physics idea from his patents. Pais tells Michels he said so to a researcher named Ashton Forbes in 2023, on Forbes's first podcast appearance, on the Hard Truths podcast: 'I told him this is the Pais.' If true, it would tie the plane's disappearance to advanced physics of the kind Pais describes.
